subject: Nanotechnology
title: DNA as a Nano Breadboard
description: Learn DNA as a Nano Breadboard in one minute.

hook.text: Electronics use breadboards for prototyping — DNA origami serves the same role at the nanoscale.

buildup.text: Each staple strand has a known position — attach a molecule to a staple and you place it with 6 nm precision.

discovery.text: Gold nanoparticles, quantum dots, carbon nanotubes, and proteins have all been placed on DNA origami platforms.

twist.text: DNA origami's addressability is unmatched — no other self-assembled platform offers so many unique binding sites.

climax.text: Researchers built a plasmonic antenna by placing gold nanoparticles at precise distances on DNA — tuning optical resonance.

punchline.text: Place anything, anywhere, at nanometer precision — DNA origami is nano's breadboard.

quiz.question: Why is DNA origami called a nano breadboard?
options: It conducts electricity like a circuit board
Each staple has a known position, allowing precise placement of functional components like a prototyping platform
It is made from organic bread-like materials
